p.SETUP-AND-RUNTIME-DOCUMENTATION-IS-LOAD-: A project's setup and runtime documentation is **load-bearing** — it is the file someone reaches for when the build breaks, the environment is wrong, or a prerequisite is missing.

p.EVERY-SETUP-TOUCHING-CHANGE-UPDATES-THE-: Every change that touches the **toolchain, prerequisites, environment variables, paths, or bootstrap steps** updates the relevant setup/runtime doc **in the same commit**.

p.NEVER-SHIP-A-SETUP-CHANGE-WITH-THE-DOC-U: Never ship a setup change with the doc update deferred — deferral is exactly where the drift these files exist to prevent lives.

facts.NEVER-DEFER-THE-DOC-UPDATE-TO-A-LATER-CO: Never ship a dev-env or runtime-setup change with its doc update in a later commit.
facts.NEVER-LET-THE-DOCS-DESCRIBE-AN-ABANDONED: Never let the setup docs describe a toolchain the project no longer uses.
